name: Faroe Islands
about: Weather is famously unpredictable — fog and wind can close ferries and hiking trails on short notice year-round; puffins nest on the cliffs roughly May–Aug.
overview: Steep sea cliffs and grass-roof villages between Iceland and Norway, with genuinely more sheep than people.
costOverview: The Faroe Islands run expensive even by Nordic standards — coffee alone costs more than a casual meal in most of Europe, and a proper restaurant dinner reaches real Scandinavian prices fast.

costItems.label: Fish fillet, casual meal with coffee

specialSeasons.text: Puffins nest on the sea cliffs — one of the easiest places in the world to see them up close.
